title: Rule enforced: R1 — Citation requires driver, violation and jurisdiction
description: A citation must reference exactly one driver, one violation type, and one issuing jurisdiction.
name: tc-rule-R1

title: Rule enforced: R10 — Citation status is computed, never stored
description: CitationStatus is re-derived on every read from raw facts and child events; there is no stored status column to drift.
name: tc-rule-R10

title: Rule enforced: R11 — No response by deadline is a default judgment
description: If the response window passes with no RespondedOn, the citation moves to Adjudicated by default.
name: tc-rule-R11

title: Rule enforced: R12 — Contest status follows the latest hearing
description: ContestStatus is derived from the newest related hearing: NotContested | HearingRequested → Scheduled → Heard.
name: tc-rule-R12

title: Rule enforced: R13 — Only a manager schedules a hearing
description: Transitioning a hearing from HearingRequested to Scheduled is a manager-role action.
name: tc-rule-R13

title: Rule enforced: R2 — Response due date is derived from the jurisdiction
description: ResponseDueDate = IssuedOn + the issuing jurisdiction's DaysToRespond. Changing the jurisdiction's rule re-derives every citation under it.
name: tc-rule-R2

title: Rule enforced: R20 — Fine is the violation's base fine
description: The amount owed starts at the violation type's BaseFineUsd for the citation's jurisdiction.
name: tc-rule-R20

title: Rule enforced: R21 — Late payment incurs a jurisdiction penalty
description: If payment is not made by the pay-by date, a penalty of LatePenaltyPct of the fine is added.
name: tc-rule-R21

title: Rule enforced: R22 — Prolonged non-payment goes to collections
description: A Late citation becomes Collections after DaysLateToCollections days past the pay-by date.
name: tc-rule-R22

title: Rule enforced: R23 — A dismissed citation owes nothing
description: If a hearing dismisses the citation, PaymentStatus is NotOwed regardless of the fine.
name: tc-rule-R23

title: Rule enforced: R3 — A response is pay or contest
description: Responding means either paying the fine or requesting a hearing; either sets RespondedOn and advances the citation to Responded.
name: tc-rule-R3

title: Rule enforced: R30 — Active points roll up to the driver
description: A driver's ActivePoints is the sum of points from adjudicated, non-dismissed citations.
name: tc-rule-R30

title: Rule enforced: R31 — Points drive license warning then suspension
description: LicenseStatus is Warning at the jurisdiction's PointWarningThreshold and Suspended at PointSuspensionThreshold.
name: tc-rule-R31

title: Rule enforced: R40 — Regulations are data, not code
description: Every regulatory knob — deadlines, fines, penalties, thresholds, school caps — is a column on Jurisdictions, editable without code changes.
name: tc-rule-R40

title: Rule enforced: R50 — Overdue work is urgent
description: A work-queue item whose due date is in the past is urgent and sorts to the top.
name: tc-rule-R50

title: Rule enforced: R51 — Work items mirror their subject's deadline
description: A work item's DueDate is carried from its subject (e.g. Citations.ResponseDueDate or PaymentDueDate).
name: tc-rule-R51

title: Rule enforced: R60 — Overrides require a reason
description: Any OVERRIDE audit entry must carry a non-empty Reason; the trail is append-only.
name: tc-rule-R60

title: Rule enforced: R70 — Every assistant turn is costed
description: Each assistant turn records input/output tokens and the exact pricing version used, so TotalCost is fully derivable.
name: tc-rule-R70

title: Rule enforced: TT-ASSISTANT-01 — Assistant answers are grounded in live data
description: The assistant answers about a citation/rule/portal from live vw_* reads and the rulebook, recording each exchange as an AssistantTurns row.
name: tc-rule-TT-ASSISTANT-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-ASSISTANT-02 — Every turn is cost-accounted
description: Each AssistantTurns row records input/output tokens and a computed cost via ModelPricingVersions for the turn's AiModel.
name: tc-rule-TT-ASSISTANT-02

title: Rule enforced: TT-AUDIT-01 — Every state-affecting change is logged
description: Each status change, override, payment, and edit writes an append-only AuditLogEntries (and where lifecycle-relevant, a CaseEvents) row.
name: tc-rule-TT-AUDIT-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-AUDIT-02 — The log never contradicts the derived state
description: The append-only history explains how current computed state was reached; it is additive narration, never an alternate source of truth.
name: tc-rule-TT-AUDIT-02

title: Rule enforced: TT-AUTH-01 — Identity is resolved per request from the magic-link session
description: Each request resolves to an AppUsers row and role via the MagicLinkConfig flow; identity feeds every RBAC and scoping decision.
name: tc-rule-TT-AUTH-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-CITATION-01 — Citation status is derived, never stored
description: CitationStatus (Issued -> Responded -> InContest -> Adjudicated -> Closed) is computed on read from facts and child CaseEvents; no stored status column is authoritative.
name: tc-rule-TT-CITATION-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-CITATION-02 — Status order is monotonic
description: A citation may only advance forward through its lifecycle states; backward transitions require an explicit, logged override.
name: tc-rule-TT-CITATION-02

title: Rule enforced: TT-CONTEST-01 — Contesting requires a timely contest response
description: The contest track only opens when DriverResponse = contest was recorded before the ResponseDeadline.
name: tc-rule-TT-CONTEST-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-CONTEST-02 — Contest track derives from the latest hearing
description: ContestStatus (NotContested | HearingRequested -> Scheduled -> Heard) is derived from the most recent Hearings row for the citation.
name: tc-rule-TT-CONTEST-02

title: Rule enforced: TT-CONTEST-03 — Determination decides liability
description: A hearing outcome of dismissed sets liability to none and zero fine owed; upheld confirms the original fine and points.
name: tc-rule-TT-CONTEST-03

title: Rule enforced: TT-DEADLINE-01 — Response deadline derives from jurisdiction DaysToRespond
description: ResponseDeadline = IssueDate + the issuing jurisdiction's DaysToRespond; it recomputes whenever the rule changes.
name: tc-rule-TT-DEADLINE-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-DETERMINATION-01 — Determination is recorded
description: A hearing determination (upheld / dismissed / reduced) must be recorded on the Citation before the citation-lifecycle may advance to adjudicated, and it writes a CaseEvents entry.
name: tc-rule-TT-DETERMINATION-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-DETERMINATION-02 — Dismissal reverses consequences
description: When a determination dismisses a Citation, any assessed license points are reversed and any paid amount is refunded, restoring the Driver to make-whole state.
name: tc-rule-TT-DETERMINATION-02

title: Rule enforced: TT-FEE-01 — Base fine comes from the violation and jurisdiction
description: The base fine is the ViolationType base amount adjusted by the jurisdiction's fee schedule; it is data, not a constant.
name: tc-rule-TT-FEE-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-GLOSSARY-01 — Domain terms are defined as data
description: Every domain term used in a feature or rule is defined in GlossaryTerms under a GlossaryCategories group.
name: tc-rule-TT-GLOSSARY-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-HEARING-01 — Hearing requires a requested contest
description: A Hearings row may only be created for a citation whose ContestStatus is HearingRequested or later.
name: tc-rule-TT-HEARING-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-HEARING-02 — Scheduling is manager-or-admin only
description: Only manager or admin roles may set a hearing's ScheduledDate; representatives request, they do not schedule.
name: tc-rule-TT-HEARING-02

title: Rule enforced: TT-INTAKE-01 — Citation requires driver, violation, jurisdiction
description: A citation must reference exactly one Driver, one ViolationType, and one issuing Jurisdiction; none may be null at intake.
name: tc-rule-TT-INTAKE-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-INTAKE-02 — Issue date present and not future-dated
description: Every citation records an IssueDate that is on or before today; a future issue date is rejected at intake.
name: tc-rule-TT-INTAKE-02

title: Rule enforced: TT-INTAKE-03 — Driver response is pay-or-contest before the deadline
description: The driver's response is one of {pay, contest} and must be recorded on or before the computed ResponseDeadline.
name: tc-rule-TT-INTAKE-03

title: Rule enforced: TT-LICENSE-01 — Active points roll up across a driver's citations
description: A driver's ActivePoints is the sum of points from non-dismissed, non-expired citations under each jurisdiction's point window.
name: tc-rule-TT-LICENSE-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-LICENSE-02 — License track follows jurisdiction thresholds
description: LicenseStatus (Valid -> Warning -> Suspended) is derived by comparing ActivePoints against the jurisdiction's warning and suspension thresholds.
name: tc-rule-TT-LICENSE-02

title: Rule enforced: TT-LICENSE-PKG-01 — Surfaces are gated by license/active flags
description: Packages, features, tables, and routes carry IsLicensed/IsActive flags; unlicensed surfaces are revealed as upgrade prompts, not deleted.
name: tc-rule-TT-LICENSE-PKG-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-NAV-01 — Navigation is derived from PlatformNaviation rows
description: The sidebar and route tree render from PlatformNaviation filtered by the current role's RoleVisibility; there is no hand-maintained menu.
name: tc-rule-TT-NAV-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-NAV-02 — Route order and pinning are data
description: NavLevel, SortOrder, and PinToTop on PlatformNaviation determine ordering and which screens float to the top.
name: tc-rule-TT-NAV-02

title: Rule enforced: TT-PAYMENT-01 — Payment track derives from payments and pay-by date
description: PaymentStatus (Pending -> Due -> Late -> Collections | Paid | NotOwed) is computed from Payments rows and the jurisdiction pay-by date.
name: tc-rule-TT-PAYMENT-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-PAYMENT-02 — Late penalty applies after the pay-by date
description: Once the pay-by date passes with no full payment, the jurisdiction's LatePenaltyPercent is added to AmountOwed.
name: tc-rule-TT-PAYMENT-02

title: Rule enforced: TT-PAYMENT-03 — Paid in full closes the case
description: When recorded Payments equal AmountOwed, PaymentStatus becomes Paid and the citation advances toward Closed.
name: tc-rule-TT-PAYMENT-03

title: Rule enforced: TT-PLATFORM-01 — The rulebook JSON is the single source of truth
description: All substrates (Postgres, Python, explain-dag, rulespeak) are mechanically derived from the rulebook by effortless build; edits go to the rulebook.
name: tc-rule-TT-PLATFORM-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-PLATFORM-02 — The platform describes itself
description: ERBTables/ERBFields/ERBFeatures/ERBPackages catalog every table, field, capability, and package so the app can render its own model.
name: tc-rule-TT-PLATFORM-02

title: Rule enforced: TT-PLATFORM-03 — Build is generate + load; drift is guarded
description: effortless build regenerates DDL/views/inserts and reloads the DB; a drift guard warns before a rebuild would clobber un-saved DB edits.
name: tc-rule-TT-PLATFORM-03

title: Rule enforced: TT-QUEUE-01 — Work queue is computed from deadlines and status
description: WorkQueueItems are derived from overdue responses, due/late payments, and upcoming hearings, bucketed by urgency; nothing is hand-enqueued.
name: tc-rule-TT-QUEUE-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-RBAC-01 — Four canonical roles govern access
description: Exactly four roles exist (admin, manager, representative, external-llm) and every permission decision references one of them.
name: tc-rule-TT-RBAC-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-RBAC-02 — CRUD is per role, per table, per field
description: What each role may create/read/update/delete is data at the table and field grain; the enforced API consults it on every operation.
name: tc-rule-TT-RBAC-02

title: Rule enforced: TT-RBAC-03 — Row access follows per-role WHERE policies
description: Each role-table pair carries a WHERE policy; a representative sees only their own citations while admin sees all, enforced on every vw_* read.
name: tc-rule-TT-RBAC-03

title: Rule enforced: TT-RBAC-04 — Lower-trust roles get redacted projections
description: Fields denied to a role (e.g. PII for external-llm) are stripped from responses at projection time, not nulled afterward.
name: tc-rule-TT-RBAC-04

title: Rule enforced: TT-RULES-01 — Jurisdiction knobs are editable data
description: Deadlines, fines, penalty percentages, and point thresholds live in Jurisdictions/JurisdictionRules and every dependent value re-derives on edit.
name: tc-rule-TT-RULES-01

title: Rule enforced: TT-RULES-02 — Each jurisdiction rule cites its source
description: A JurisdictionRules row links to the JurisdictionSourceDocuments / ReferenceDocuments authority that justifies it.
name: tc-rule-TT-RULES-02

title: Rule enforced: TT-STATE-01 — Lifecycle transitions are guarded
description: Every state transition is gated by its guard condition and the firing role; the state-machine backbone rejects illegal transitions and logs each accepted one to CaseEvents.
name: tc-rule-TT-STATE-01

title: Transition: citation-lifecycle--adjudicated->closed
description: Guard 'Fine paid in full or citation dismissed.' allows citation-lifecycle--adjudicated -> citation-lifecycle--closed for role system.
name: tc-transition-citation-lifecycle--adjudicated->closed

title: Transition: citation-lifecycle--incontest->adjudicated
description: Guard 'Hearing returns a guilty/upheld outcome.' allows citation-lifecycle--incontest -> citation-lifecycle--adjudicated for role system.
name: tc-transition-citation-lifecycle--incontest->adjudicated

title: Transition: citation-lifecycle--incontest->dismissed
description: Guard 'Contest succeeds; citation dismissed and points reversed.' allows citation-lifecycle--incontest -> citation-lifecycle--dismissed for role manager.
name: tc-transition-citation-lifecycle--incontest->dismissed

title: Transition: citation-lifecycle--issued->adjudicated
description: Guard 'Response deadline passes with no response (default).' allows citation-lifecycle--issued -> citation-lifecycle--adjudicated for role system.
name: tc-transition-citation-lifecycle--issued->adjudicated

title: Transition: citation-lifecycle--issued->responded
description: Guard 'Driver responds (pays or requests hearing).' allows citation-lifecycle--issued -> citation-lifecycle--responded for role representative.
name: tc-transition-citation-lifecycle--issued->responded

title: Transition: citation-lifecycle--responded->incontest
description: Guard 'Driver elects to contest and a hearing exists.' allows citation-lifecycle--responded -> citation-lifecycle--incontest for role representative.
name: tc-transition-citation-lifecycle--responded->incontest

title: Transition: contest-track--heard->dismissed
description: Guard 'Hearing determination dismisses the citation.' allows contest-track--heard -> contest-track--dismissed for role manager.
name: tc-transition-contest-track--heard->dismissed

title: Transition: contest-track--heard->reduced
description: Guard 'Hearing determination reduces the violation or fine.' allows contest-track--heard -> contest-track--reduced for role manager.
name: tc-transition-contest-track--heard->reduced

title: Transition: contest-track--heard->upheld
description: Guard 'Hearing determination upholds the citation in full.' allows contest-track--heard -> contest-track--upheld for role manager.
name: tc-transition-contest-track--heard->upheld

title: Transition: contest-track--hearingrequested->scheduled
description: Guard 'Court schedules the hearing.' allows contest-track--hearingrequested -> contest-track--scheduled for role manager.
name: tc-transition-contest-track--hearingrequested->scheduled

title: Transition: contest-track--hearingrequested->withdrawn
description: Guard 'Representative withdraws the contest before the hearing.' allows contest-track--hearingrequested -> contest-track--withdrawn for role representative.
name: tc-transition-contest-track--hearingrequested->withdrawn

title: Transition: contest-track--notcontested->hearingrequested
description: Guard 'Driver requests a hearing.' allows contest-track--notcontested -> contest-track--hearingrequested for role representative.
name: tc-transition-contest-track--notcontested->hearingrequested

title: Transition: contest-track--scheduled->heard
description: Guard 'Hearing is held and an outcome recorded.' allows contest-track--scheduled -> contest-track--heard for role manager.
name: tc-transition-contest-track--scheduled->heard

title: Transition: contest-track--scheduled->withdrawn
description: Guard 'Contest withdrawn after scheduling but before hearing.' allows contest-track--scheduled -> contest-track--withdrawn for role representative.
name: tc-transition-contest-track--scheduled->withdrawn

title: Transition: license-track--pointsassessed->warning
description: Guard 'Accumulated points cross the warning threshold.' allows license-track--pointsassessed -> license-track--warning for role manager.
name: tc-transition-license-track--pointsassessed->warning

title: Transition: license-track--suspended->reinstated
description: Guard 'Points reduced (dismissal/time) below threshold; license reinstated.' allows license-track--suspended -> license-track--reinstated for role admin.
name: tc-transition-license-track--suspended->reinstated

title: Transition: license-track--valid->pointsassessed
description: Guard 'Adjudicated citation assesses license points.' allows license-track--valid -> license-track--pointsassessed for role manager.
name: tc-transition-license-track--valid->pointsassessed

title: Transition: license-track--valid->warning
description: Guard 'Active points reach the warning threshold.' allows license-track--valid -> license-track--warning for role system.
name: tc-transition-license-track--valid->warning

title: Transition: license-track--warning->suspended
description: Guard 'Active points reach the suspension threshold.' allows license-track--warning -> license-track--suspended for role system.
name: tc-transition-license-track--warning->suspended

title: Transition: payment-track--collections->paid
description: Guard 'Driver settles the outstanding balance in collections.' allows payment-track--collections -> payment-track--paid for role representative.
name: tc-transition-payment-track--collections->paid

title: Transition: payment-track--due->late
description: Guard 'Payment due date passes unpaid.' allows payment-track--due -> payment-track--late for role system.
name: tc-transition-payment-track--due->late

title: Transition: payment-track--due->paid
description: Guard 'Driver pays in full.' allows payment-track--due -> payment-track--paid for role representative.
name: tc-transition-payment-track--due->paid

title: Transition: payment-track--late->collections
description: Guard 'Late beyond the jurisdiction's collections window.' allows payment-track--late -> payment-track--collections for role system.
name: tc-transition-payment-track--late->collections

title: Transition: payment-track--paid->notowed
description: Guard 'Citation dismissed after payment; refund issued.' allows payment-track--paid -> payment-track--notowed for role manager.
name: tc-transition-payment-track--paid->notowed

title: Transition: payment-track--pending->due
description: Guard 'Driver found liable; fine assessed.' allows payment-track--pending -> payment-track--due for role system.
name: tc-transition-payment-track--pending->due

title: Transition: payment-track--pending->notowed
description: Guard 'Citation dismissed at hearing.' allows payment-track--pending -> payment-track--notowed for role system.
name: tc-transition-payment-track--pending->notowed
